action: I would check the completion indicator before deciding whether the PDF is ready for my review.
observed: Implementation review only; no browser interactions performed. The template presents a section percentage, a Ready stage, and Document ready for completed jobs. The explanation that Completed means the PDF compiled, not that the content was verified is inside a collapsed Generation details element, conditional on FreeDraft. The download is labelled Draft PDF or Outline PDF.
problem: The prominent readiness signals can lead me to interpret a full section count as verified content before I discover the qualification hidden below the downloads.
suggestion: Show PDF compiled — content needs review beside the completion status and downloads, with the unresolved-gap count visible without expanding details.

action: I would read the privacy wording to decide whether submitting the project is acceptable.
observed: Implementation review only. The landing page says Everything stays in this browser session, while its form posts uploaded files to /jobs and the collapsed Model keys section says Keys are encrypted on this server. The document page describes downloads as private to this browser.
problem: I could mistake browser-bound access for local-only processing or storage, and submit source under an incorrect understanding of where it goes.
heuristic: Match between system and the real world
suggestion: Replace the session claim with a visible explanation that files are uploaded to the server and access is tied to this browser session, alongside the actual retention policy.

action: When the completed document has missing sections, I would follow the warning's Retry saved stage advice.
observed: Implementation review only. The warning for completed FreeDraft jobs whose outcome is not draft_ready advises using Retry saved stage. That button is rendered only for failed, cancelled, or retry_wait status, so it is absent in the same completed state that displays the advice. document.html separately offers Continue unfinished sections when FreeDraft and Editable are true.
problem: The recovery instruction points me to an unavailable control, leaving me unsure how to obtain a fuller document for review.
heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
suggestion: For completed partial drafts, link directly to the available Continue unfinished sections action and explain its prerequisites; reserve Retry saved stage advice for states where that control exists.
